name: cache-live-control
description: Change the prompt-cache TTL (5m, 1h or automatic) of one Claude Code chat with /cache: instantly, with no model turn, for the main chat, its sub-agents or both.

mainTtl.title: Main chat: starting cache TTL
mainTtl.description: The main chat's prompt-cache TTL at session start: "5m", "1h", or empty to leave it automatic. A CLAUDE_CODE_PROMPT_CACHE_TTL set at launch wins.

subagentTtl.title: Sub-agents: starting cache TTL
subagentTtl.description: The sub-agents' prompt-cache TTL at session start: "5m", "1h", or empty to leave it automatic. A CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_PROMPT_CACHE_TTL set at launch wins.

ttlNotice.title: Tell the main chat its cache TTL
ttlNotice.description: On: the main chat's first prompt, and the first prompt after its TTL changes or the chat compacts or clears, carries a short note to the model: which TTL it runs on, and whether to delegate long work to sub-agents (1h) or keep work in the chat (5m). Sub-agents never get it.

raiseAfterExpiries.title: Main chat: raise to 1h after N expired wake-ups
raiseAfterExpiries.description: A whole number of 1 or more, or empty to leave it off. When the main chat runs at 5m and wakes to an expired cache for the Nth time in a session, that wake's request goes out at 1h and the main chat stays at 1h for the rest of the session. An explicit /cache main resets the count, and /cache main 5m switches the raise off for the session; FORCE_PROMPT_CACHING_5M and the sub-agents are never touched.

resumeGuard.title: Sub-agents: guard against resuming a cold agent
resumeGuard.description: "warn", "block", or empty/"off" to leave it off. A SendMessage to a sub-agent whose prompt cache has expired and whose context is at least resumeGuardMinTokens re-writes that whole context at the cache-write price. warn sends the message and tells the sender what it cost; block refuses it, naming the cost, until the sender repeats the message beginning with [resume-anyway].

resumeGuardMinTokens.title: Resume guard: context floor
resumeGuardMinTokens.description: Tokens, such as 60000 or 60k: a cold agent with a smaller context is resumed without a word, since resuming it costs about what a fresh agent does.

resumeGuardPrice.title: Resume guard: base input price (optional)
resumeGuardPrice.description: USD per million base input tokens, such as 3 or 15. When set, the guard's text also shows the rewrite in dollars; empty shows tokens only (this plugin holds no price table).

agentRaiseWaiting.title: Sub-agents: 1h when an agent launches background work
agentRaiseWaiting.description: On: while a sub-agent that launched a background sub-agent or a background shell is finishing its turn, every sub-agent request is written at 1h (they share one process-wide variable, so no agent can be raised alone), so its wake reads the cache. Costs 2x instead of 1.25x on every sub-agent cache write meanwhile. A typed /cache agents setting outranks it; FORCE_PROMPT_CACHING_5M and the main chat are never touched.

agentRaiseAfterExpiries.title: Sub-agents: 1h after N expired requests of one agent
agentRaiseAfterExpiries.description: A whole number of 1 or more, or empty to leave it off. Once one sub-agent has found its own cache expired N times, every sub-agent request is written at 1h until that agent finishes or has been idle for an hour (same shared variable and cost as agentRaiseWaiting).

handoff.title: Sub-agents: ask for a handoff file
handoff.description: On: every sub-agent's prompt gets a short instruction to write a handoff (state, decisions, next steps, file:line anchors, open questions) to a file before its final answer; the resume guard then points to that file, so a fresh agent can start from it instead of resuming a cold one.

handoffDir.title: Handoff files: directory
handoffDir.description: Where handoff files go, as an absolute path (a relative one is ignored). Empty uses this plugin's own data directory (<Claude config dir>/plugins/data/<plugin>-<marketplace>/handoffs).
